secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Signing key for the store's session cookie. A development value is generated automatically; replace it with a long random string before any real deployment.

secrets.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Password for the bootstrap administrator account (ADMIN_EMAIL, default admin@auroraskincare.example). Used once on first boot to create the account; change it from the admin dashboard or set your own value here. There is a clearly-labelled development placeholder in .env.base44-defaults.
